reason: The current folder-and-chat setup works fine and I'm not the one who moves first anyway. If the group actually migrates over I'll follow along, but I'm not switching readers on my own for a site that might be dead in two weeks.
objection: Will the others actually use it, or does it die in two weeks — if half the chat stays on Discord and someone's shared drive, we just end up with one more thing to check.
would_change_my_mind: If most of the group actually moved onto it and kept using it for a few weeks, so it isn't just another ghost site.
